args.head: ci/frontend-parity-logs-native-green-c714-20261116
args.title: ci: qualify Host Logs and native lifecycle on frozen source
args.body:
## Purpose

Run the unchanged original acceptance workflows on the reviewed Host Logs/Thinking/stderr and native lifecycle source, including its published stderr privacy repair, loaded-CDP source pin and passive Team-navigation diagnostics. Keep primary PR1192 and frozen venues1206/1207/1208 unchanged.

## Exact frozen source

Base: `ci/frontend-parity-logs-native-base-c714-20261116` at `0b3fa6117b1856b947d799f95bae7aae0238061c`, tree `6c697970d954f2ef4534e01487b2faf54d2a14e0`.
Head: `ci/frontend-parity-logs-native-green-c714-20261116` at `2abcf83fddacbc1efedee83f9c1d203d12ed656e`, tree `0b3ff52f7d0bbfb8544e4a9295acb9f2f24ca103`.

The complete comparison is ahead26/behind0 with194 changed files:72 outside docs and122 docs/evidence,62 modified and132 added, no deletion or mode change. Seventeen incoming commits, the a3a9 integration merge and eight later own commits remain reachable. Original15-second Process readiness, distinct P08 deadlines and all custody/cleanup gates remain selected. The519-file later incoming evidence/history reconciliation stays outside this frozen head.

## Existing evidence and remaining qualification

Source-bound earlier local results retain170 whole-file Node,59 Vitest and41 Desktop-observation PASS; the original closure serializer refusal and its sole LF correction remain recorded. The privacy repair separately passed47 whole-file cases after its actual22PASS/5FAIL regression stage. The CDP pin passed its three scoped static checks.

On this exact2ab head, the complete desktop-team-ui smoke file passed49/49 (44 original plus five observer cases), with scoped two-file lint, source-size, provisioning, source diff and source closure all0: six commands total, no new build or compiler. These results do not establish GUI/native/platform qualification or a historical navigation cause.

The original resulting-source CI must retain full logs/API/artifacts for eighteen Desktop journeys, four safe shards, five Process tuples, five packaged tuples, nine Stage1 jobs and three Teams Create-page journeys, including original types and physical cleanup. Failed, skipped, cancelled and unreached work remains unqualified.

## Automatic workflow scope

All42 reviewed workflow definitions and the full194-file range were reviewed:21 definitions match opened; six are entirely Draft-skipped. Matched landing/updater routes retain original static/quality checks and exclude PR deployment/native-updater execution through existing guards. Actual Claude/Codex commands, including versions, remain excluded. Existing pinned OpenCode/local TEST fixtures remain allowed.

General CI keeps Draft fast feedback and its original full-qualification refusal. This PR stays Draft. No label/Ready conversion, workflow edit, manual dispatch/rerun/cancel, primary-head move, release or provider ref action is requested. Both new refs remain frozen; their new PR concurrency cannot cancel another PR's cohort.
